title: 병원 진료: 진찰, 처방, 주사
objective: By the end, you can use words for a hospital visit, such as 진찰, 처방전, 주사, 치료 and 입원하다, in short sentences. You can also use the right verbs with them, such as 주사를 맞다 and 치료를 받다.
summary: Learn ten words you will hear and use from the hospital front desk to the pharmacy, from check-in and the exam to shots, treatment, and staying in the hospital.

task.title: Use hospital words
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, put the steps in order, or answer in Korean.

words.meaning: to check in at the hospital front desk
words.exampleMeaning: If this is your first visit, please check in over there first.

words.meaning: a doctor's examination of a patient (진찰을 받다: to see the doctor)
words.example: 열이 계속 나서 내일 진찰을 받으려고요.
words.exampleMeaning: I keep having a fever, so I'm going to see a doctor tomorrow.

words.meaning: a medical test, such as a blood test or an X-ray
words.exampleMeaning: The test results come out in a week.

words.meaning: a shot or injection (주사를 맞다: to get a shot)
words.example: 주사 한 대 맞으면 금방 괜찮아질 거예요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you get a shot, you'll feel better soon.

words.meaning: a prescription (the paper you take to the pharmacy)
words.exampleMeaning: I lost my prescription, so I came back to get a new one.

words.meaning: medical treatment (치료를 받다: to get treatment)
words.example: 무릎 치료를 받으러 일주일에 두 번 병원에 다녀요.
words.exampleMeaning: I go to the hospital twice a week to get treatment for my knee.

words.meaning: to be admitted to the hospital and stay there
words.exampleMeaning: I hurt my leg, so I was in the hospital for a week.

words.meaning: to leave the hospital after a stay
words.exampleMeaning: Doctor, around when can I leave the hospital?

words.meaning: surgery, an operation (수술을 받다: to have surgery)
words.exampleMeaning: The surgery will take about two hours.

words.meaning: the fee for seeing a doctor, the medical bill
words.exampleMeaning: You can pay the medical bill on the first floor on your way out.

exercises: Choose the right word for each blank (진찰 / 검사 / 수술). Use each word once: ① 의사 선생님이 목 안을 보고 ____을 했어요. ② 피를 조금 뽑아서 ____을 했어요. ③ 의사가 배를 열고 ____을 했어요.
Fill in the blank with 입원 or 퇴원: ① 많이 좋아져서 내일 ____해요. ② 교통사고가 나서 지금 병원에 ____해 있어요.
Choose the right verb: ① 독감 예방 주사를 (맞았어요 / 먹었어요). ② 이가 아파서 치과에서 치료를 (받았어요 / 맞았어요).
Put the steps of a hospital visit in order: (A) 약국에 가요. (B) 접수해요. (C) 처방전을 받아요. (D) 진찰을 받아요.
Read what the nurse says and answer in Korean. 간호사: "진료비는 2층 창구에서 내세요. 처방전은 병원 앞 약국에 가져가시면 돼요." ① 진료비는 어디에서 내요? ② 처방전은 어디에 가져가요?
answers: ① 진찰 ② 검사 ③ 수술
B → D → C → A (접수해요 → 진찰을 받아요 → 처방전을 받아요 → 약국에 가요)
① 2층 창구에서 내요. ② 병원 앞 약국에 가져가요.
